description.text: Starting Date: September 1 to 5 Notes: Those who miss the application deadline can submit your application materials before September 1st at the latest.

duration.text: The Marine Pharmacy at China Pharmaceutical University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3472 USD/per year ￥ 25000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Certificate of HSK (No Need for English Medium Programs) Certificate of HSK (Chinese Proficiency Test) 2.Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included 3.Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant 4.Certificate/diploma of highest education Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. 5.Academic transcript of highest education 6.Two letters of recommendation From professor or associate professor or equivalents

requirements.text: 1.Applicants for Doctoral program should have a Master's degree or equivalent academic background; 2.Healthy and under the age of 45.
